title: Set-inspection coverage matrix of a requirement stage
description: From the Forge-C requirements quality guideline v1.0, section 3.1: each upstream source and each applicable scenario is Covered, Partial, Gap or N/A. N/A needs a reason, and a missing input is a Gap / NEEDS_INPUT, never N/A. The set inspector proposes the rows. The conductor checks them and raises a finding for every gap that no finding or open point already tracks.

provided.description: false when the inspector's reply had no coverage rows

source.description: an upstream id (STK, SYS, use case, <doc_id>#<section>) or a scenario name

tracked_by.description: the finding or open point that tracks a partial or gap row

adjusted.description: what the conductor changed in the rows and why
